title: MedInfo Desk (medical information for an oncology and diabetes portfolio)
summary: Five roles including external HCP portal logins and MSLs scoped to their own submissions, a standard response library with maker-checker approval and yearly review, inquiries from portal, toll-free line, mailbox and MSLs with SLA due dates and an unsolicited-request check, standard, adapted and custom responses with medical review before sending, a follow-up log, AE capture forwarded to PV within one business day with safety case IDs, CRM sync and literature search, and inquiry and reporter 360 pages.
